findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: web_read, email_auth, business_check, domain_security_report, web_page_report, email_validator, sitemap_extractor · Private data: federal_register, email_auth, domain_security_report, airport_report, iban_validator, sepa_xml, pdf_merge, pdf_split, pdf_compress, pdf_to_image, images_to_pdf, pdf_protect, image_compress, image_resize, image_convert, data_convert · Public sink: email_auth, business_check, invoice_generator, pdf_merge, email_validator · Destructive: iban_validator, pdf_split, pdf_protect, image_compress.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: web_read, email_auth, business_check, domain_security_report, web_page_report, email_validator, sitemap_extractor · Private data: federal_register, email_auth, domain_security_report, airport_report, iban_validator, sepa_xml, pdf_merge, pdf_split, pdf_compress, pdf_to_image, images_to_pdf, pdf_protect, image_compress, image_resize, image_convert, data_convert · Public sink: email_auth, business_check, invoice_generator, pdf_merge, email_validator · Destructive: iban_validator, pdf_split, pdf_protect, image_compress

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
